title: Cain
summary: Cain functions as a warning figure whose story highlights resistance to God's purposes.
historical_context: This figure appears in conflict settings where power, pride, or unbelief oppose God's redemptive work.
ancient_near_east_context: Royal courts, religious leadership, and imperial pressure often frame the background.
literary_context: The narrative uses Cain to expose compromise, hostility, or judgment.
covenantal_significance: Cain shows what happens when human power resists covenant faithfulness.
interpretive_notes: These figures are usually read as cautionary, not exemplary, characters.
Their stories often illustrate the consequences of resisting God's purposes.
